decisions: Vanilla ES modules, Electron and Android WebView; preserve framework and native audio services.
Twenty numbered experiments are enabled in js/visual-features.js; reversible individually.
Waveforms contain actual decoded PCM peaks; no synthetic placeholder waveform.
Reuse existing surface menus, playback controls and artwork caching. No continuous blur/glow or entry animations on scrolling rows.
User approved interface proposal items 1,2,6-14,16-20 on 2026-10-18; exclude 3,4,5,15, including any new home pins, recommendation shelves, listening-history view or filter chips.
Keep six themes and the approved Cyrillic headphone icon. Increase semantic surface contrast; use restrained cover tints without continuous blur or animated scrolling rows.
Reuse ES-module controls and dialogs. Separate Windows mini-player sends commands to the original audio session; Android keeps native playback. Keyboard actions and reduced-motion do not fly artwork.
